description: This file contains the server-side logic for the ExamResult web page, handling page load events to retrieve and update user exam results, session management, and navigation controls.

classes.name: ExamResult
classes.description: Partial class for ExamResult page, handling user interface events and page lifecycle for displaying exam results.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the page load event; retrieves user session data, updates database with new exam scores, and displays exam details.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Handles navigation to the dashboard page when the home button is clicked.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Handles navigation to the user profile page.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Handles navigation to the leaderboard page.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Handles logout action, redirecting to login page.
